doctors.title: Medical Specialists Directory
doctors.subtitle: Meet our compassionate, certified physicians dedicated to delivering thoughtful clinical care.

drElena.name: Dr. Elena Vance
drElena.title: Consultant Cardiologist
drElena.bio: Dr. Elena Vance brings 14 years of clinical experience in preventive cardiology, non-invasive cardiac imaging, and hypertensive disorders across renowned European healthcare centers.
drElena.edu2: Fellow of the European Society of Cardiology (FESC)
drElena.edu3: Post-Doctoral Fellowship in Vascular Medicine – Berlin

drTariq.name: Dr. Tariq Mansour
drTariq.title: Consultant Internal Medicine
drTariq.bio: Dr. Tariq Mansour has spent over 16 years diagnosing complex multisystem conditions, metabolic management, and conducting executive wellness evaluations.

drSarah.name: Dr. Sarah Jenkins
drSarah.title: Specialist Dermatologist
drSarah.bio: Dr. Sarah Jenkins is passionate about evidence-based dermatological care, focusing on allergic skin reactions, rosacea, acne therapeutics, and digital dermoscopy.
drSarah.edu1: MD – McGill University Faculty of Medicine
drSarah.edu2: Royal College of Physicians & Surgeons Certification

drKhalid.name: Dr. Khalid Al-Omari
drKhalid.title: Consultant Orthopedic Surgeon & Rehab
drKhalid.bio: Dr. Khalid Al-Omari specializes in conservative joint restoration, sports injury rehabilitation, spinal biomechanics, and evidence-guided non-surgical therapies.
drKhalid.edu2: German Board Certification in Orthopedic Surgery (Facharzt)
